channel.title: AI GridWatch — Alabama data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Alabama, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Birmingham: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month moratorium on 20+ MW facilities, unanimous. Exempts the Nebius AI factory project (application already under review)

item.title: Homewood: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, extendable 6 months. Preemptive — no data center proposals pending. Staff and Planning Commission to study zoning, operational, and infrastructure standards

item.title: Leeds: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data center applications and permits, unanimous (Ord. 2026-06-02). Preemptive — no active proposals, but residents flagged Alabama Power marketing of nearby Grand River site to data center developers

item.title: Springville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data center proposals. Preemptive — no proposals in pipeline

item.title: Cullman: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, unanimous (Res. 2026-116). Council also referred Ord. 2026-42 to Planning Commission to prohibit data centers outright. County cannot follow suit — limited home rule

item.title: Fort Payne: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month moratorium, unanimous. Preemptive — no developer inquiries. Proposed zoning: M2 heavy-industrial only, conditional use, 1,000-ft residential setback, EIS, water-use plan, noise standards

item.title: Pinson: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium targeting hyper/mega data centers, especially AI facilities. Preemptive — no proposals pending

item.title: Fairfield: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Temporary moratorium after resident pressure over Patmos (Missouri AI co.) proposal to convert former Walmart to colocation data center. Duration not specified
